A score sitting exactly on your number does not fire. If there is no score on file, nothing fires. card upgrade case Off — Looks for a documented reason to talk to this client about a better card: their total card use is over the percentage you set, or one card is over on its own, or they are carrying a balance on a card that costs more than their own cheapest card. It compares the client only with themselves and says nothing about what any lender would offer.
